contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), irregular Fallen Horseman issue of 355-361, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Head right. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman. Reverse inscription: [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Diameter: 11.4mm, Weight: 0.69gms, die axis: 6
